title: Megastigmanes isolated from Boehmeria nivea leaves and their immunomodulatory effect on IL-1β and IL-10 production in RAW264.7 macrophages
content:

With the aim of isolating immunomodulatory compounds from the n-butanol extract of Boehmeria nivea leaves, nine megastigmane compounds were identified.
